content: 查询成功！让我保存这个成功的查询模式：

args.sql: SELECT p.productid AS "产品ID", p.name AS "产品名称", pi.locationid AS "库位ID", pi.quantity AS "数量", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pi.locationid ORDER BY pi.quantity DESC) AS "排名" FROM production.productinventory pi INNER JOIN production.product p ON pi.productid = p.productid WHERE pi.locationid BETWEEN 3 AND 4 ORDER BY pi.locationid, pi.quantity DESC;

arguments.question: 查询locationID在 3 到 4 之间的库存产品，按其数量进行排名。结果需按LocationID进行分区，并根据数量进行排序。返回字段包括：产品 ID、名称、库位 ID、数量及其排名。
